name: The-system (Three-Zone + Moten)
install: if [ -x .cursor/scripts/cloud-agent-install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/scripts/cloud-agent-install.sh; else if [ -f three-zone-mvp/requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r three-zone-mvp/requirements.txt; fi; if [ -f apps/control-plane/requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r apps/control-plane/requirements.txt; fi; fi
start: if [ -x .cursor/scripts/cloud-agent-start.sh ]; then bash .cursor/scripts/cloud-agent-start.sh; else set -e; if [ -f three-zone-mvp/run.py ]; then curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health >/dev/null || (cd three-zone-mvp && TZ_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0 TZ_WS_HOST=0.0.0.0 TZ_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8000,http://localhost:8000 python3 run.py --http-port 8000 --ws-port 8765 --host 0.0.0.0 >>/tmp/cloud-agent-apps.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health; fi; if [ -f apps/control-plane/manage.py ]; then curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8100/healthz >/dev/null || (cd apps/control-plane && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=8100 python3 manage.py serve >>/tmp/cloud-agent-apps.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8100/healthz && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8100/healthz; fi; fi

terminals.name: app-logs
terminals.description: App server logs. Three-Zone Sports Access (main): http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and /ops (health GET /api/health). Moten Phase 1: http://127.0.0.1:8100/ (health GET /healthz).
